description: This file defines an abstract test runner class for transaction concurrency tests using xUnit in the Orleans framework. It inherits from a base test class and specifies test methods with data-driven tests that are skipped due to known issues.

classes.name: TransactionConcurrencyTestRunnerxUnit
classes.description: An abstract class that extends TransactionConcurrencyTestRunner to provide xUnit-specific testing functionalities for transaction concurrency tests.

methods.name: SingleSharedGrainTest
methods.description: Overrides a base method to test scenarios where two transactions share a single grain, with test data parameters indicating grain states.

methods.name: TransactionChainTest
methods.description: Overrides a base method to test chained transactions where each depends on the previous.

methods.name: TransactionTreeTest
methods.description: Overrides a base method to test transactions with a hierarchical (tree-like) dependency structure.
